cases.evidence_note: Fees of $2,500 for acting as executor of a relative's estate (not a business): reported on line 8z in full (Pub. 525 p. 33).
Found property kept, worth $400: taxable at its fair market value (Pub. 525 p. 33).
Punitive damages of $5,000 in a case not about a physical injury or sickness: ordinary income (Pub. 525 p. 32).
Damages in a case about a physical injury: refused at the entry (oi8z.injury_if_damages). The refused values are the evaluator's.

oi8z[z0].taxable.form: Pub. 525, Court awards and damages (Schedule 1, line 8z)
oi8z[z0].taxable.remedy: Damages or a settlement paid in a case about a physical injury or physical sickness are split between the compensatory part, which is not income, and any punitive damages, which are; that is outside this tool.

cite.locator: p. 32, Court awards and damages, "Punitive damages in most cases. It doesn’t matter if they relate to a physical injury or physical sickness"
